title: Curl cli is getting stuck and unable to download large files(>2MB) when curl built with msquic
body:
### I did this

I built curl using below https://github.com/curl/curl/blob/master/docs/HTTP3.md#msh3-msquic-version and tried downloading files (>2MB) but unable to download.On the other hand i am able to download large files (1GB) when curl built with quiche or ngtcp2.

Below is curl client logs

